$comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the review-md x-callback URL API. The plugin registers one Obsidian protocol handler per operations[].action and validates incoming URLs against this file (src/main.ts); scripts/gen-xcallback-api.mjs generates docs/api/* from it. Edit here, then run `make api-docs` (the pre-commit hook fails if the generated docs drift). NOTE: Obsidian reserves the `action` and `vault` query params (it overwrites `action` with the handler name and consumes `vault` for routing) — never define a param with either name. The operation is selected by the action name itself, not a query param. See docs/issues/xcallback-reserved-params.md.
name: review-md x-callback URL API
description: Drive the review-md Obsidian plugin from other apps and agents via `obsidian://review-md-<operation>?...` URLs. Each operation is its own Obsidian action (URL endpoint) and follows the x-callback-url convention: pass `x-success`/`x-error` URLs to be opened when the operation finishes. Parameter values are URL-encoded strings. The `vault` parameter is required in the URL so Obsidian routes to the right vault window; the plugin itself resolves `file` against the active vault.

operations.summary: Open a file in the reviewer
operations.description: Open a markdown file in the review-md reviewer and, optionally, scroll to a specific comment thread.

params.name: vault
params.description: Name of the target Obsidian vault. Consumed by Obsidian to route to the vault window (required in the URL, but not delivered to the plugin).

params.name: file
params.description: Vault-relative path to the markdown file to open.

params.name: thread
params.description: Thread id (the file's `^blockId`) to scroll to after opening.

params.name: x-success
params.description: URL opened when the operation succeeds (x-callback-url).

params.name: x-error
params.description: URL opened when the operation fails (x-callback-url).

operations.description: Append a message to an existing comment thread stored in the file's frontmatter, then open the file at that thread.

params.name: vault
params.description: Name of the target Obsidian vault. Consumed by Obsidian to route to the vault window (required in the URL, but not delivered to the plugin).

params.name: file
params.description: Vault-relative path to the markdown file that holds the thread.

params.name: thread
params.description: Id of the thread to reply to.

params.name: body
params.description: The reply text. URL-encode newlines and special characters.
params.example: agreed — let's keep it in frontmatter

params.name: author
params.description: Author name recorded on the reply.

params.name: x-success
params.description: URL opened when the reply is stored (x-callback-url).

params.name: x-error
params.description: URL opened when the reply fails (x-callback-url).

operations.description: Mark a comment thread resolved (the default) or open again. Use it after answering a thread, so answered threads don't pile up as open.

params.name: vault
params.description: Name of the target Obsidian vault. Consumed by Obsidian to route to the vault window (required in the URL, but not delivered to the plugin).

params.name: file
params.description: Vault-relative path to the markdown file that holds the thread.

params.name: thread
params.description: Id of the thread to resolve or reopen.

params.name: state
params.description: `resolved` closes the thread; `open` reopens it.

params.name: x-success
params.description: URL opened once the thread's state is stored (x-callback-url).

params.name: x-error
params.description: URL opened when the operation fails (x-callback-url).

operations.summary: Copy threads to the clipboard for an AI tool
operations.description: Gather comment threads — from one file, or every file in the vault — into a Markdown digest (anchor, state, messages, and an open/reply link per thread) and copy it to the clipboard, ready to paste into any AI chat. Open threads only unless `resolved=include`. The same digest `npm run reviews -- list` prints from a clone.

params.name: vault
params.description: Name of the target Obsidian vault. Consumed by Obsidian to route to the vault window (required in the URL, but not delivered to the plugin).

params.name: file
params.description: Vault-relative path of one file to export. Omit to export every file with comments.

params.name: text
params.description: Only threads whose messages, authors or anchor contain this text (case-insensitive — the same match as the panel's search box).

params.name: resolved
params.description: Whether resolved threads are included.

params.name: x-success
params.description: URL opened once the digest is on the clipboard (x-callback-url).

params.name: x-error
params.description: URL opened when the export fails (x-callback-url).
